page.overview:
Who is Big Blooper?

Big Blooper is a boss who appears in Chapter 3-2 of Super Paper Mario.

The Big Blooper is a Blooper who gigantic enough to occupy even most of the background space. It has several tentacles with only one having red suction cups on it while the rest are blue.

As Mario, Princess Peach, and Bowser swim through the Tile Pool in order to reach Fort Francis to rescue Tippi, the Big Blooper suddenly appears upset that there are trespassers. It is blocking the way to the Tile Pool, therefore preventing the party from reaching Fort Francis. Big Blooper traps off the heroes and engages them in battle. After the heroes defeat the Big Blooper, it swims away never be seen again.

During the battle against Big Blooper, the player may damage it by jumping on the tentacles when they are sticking up out of the water. The player may also use Thudley to ground-pound the tentacles or use Bowser's Fire Breath to damage them. If the player miss a tentacle when ground pounding, they will lose Heart Points. Slamming or burning the blue tentacles makes the more-sensitive red tentacles bob upward with more frequency. If Mario goes into 3D and tries to leave, the Big Blooper's tentacles will block the way.
